title: 2018 and 2019: Scanning WebSockets
description: Student Hall of Fame entries for WebSocket scanning phases in 2018 and 2019 Summer GSoC

chapters.title: WebSocket scanning phase 1
chapters.text: Manos Kirtas is listed for Scanning websockets, phase 1 (2018 Summer). The commit "WebSocket regex & non-regex filter #1382 (#1506)" is dated 2018-04-27.

chapters.title: WebSocket scanning phase 2
chapters.text: In 2019, Manos Kirtas is also listed for Scanning websockets, phase 2. The commit "[WS-Passive-Scan] Infrastructure & Passive Script Plugin" is dated 2019-07-04. In 2019 Nirojan Selvanathan is also listed for the ZAP API documentation (Season of Docs), which is kept in the separate zap-api-docs repository.
